page_title: PIS 1-1 ATA | Pisa v Atalanta 16/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' The ball goes out of play. Pisa are awarded a corner kick.
90+1' We are about to witness a subsitution. Rosen Bozhinov (Pisa) for Arturo Calabresi.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
87' 1 - 1 Rafiu Durosinmi (Pisa) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header low inside the right post. Excellent finish.
86' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Michel Aebischer (Pisa). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
85' Matteo Marchetti sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
85' Celebrations by Atalanta are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
83' 0 - 1 Goal! Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top of the net. It's 0:1.
82' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
82' An attempted cross from Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is cleared.
82' Free kick. Atalanta will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
82' Raffaele Palladino prepares a substitution. Nicola Zalewski is replaced by Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta).
81' Francesco Coppola (Pisa) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
80' Samuele Angori (Pisa) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
79' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
79' The current number of shots on goal is 4:2.
77' The ball is out of play. Pisa will have a chance to score from a corner.
70' That's the end of the game for Giorgio Scalvini, who is replaced by Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta).
68' Alberto Gilardino has decided to make a change. Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) replaces Matteo Tramoni.
68' Alberto Gilardino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rafiu Durosinmi (Pisa) replacing Henrik Meister.
68' The substitution is prepared. Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Marius Marin.
66' Matteo Marchetti shows the yellow card to Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) for a heavy challenge.
65' Atalanta seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

62' Fine attempt! Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Pisa will have a goal kick.
61' The ball is out of play. Pisa win a corner kick.
58' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
56' Today's match ends for Mario Pasalic who will be replaced by Ederson (Atalanta).
56' Here is a change. Yunus Musah is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta).
56' Gianluca Scamacca will be replaced by Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta).

55' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Matteo Marchetti with no other option than to blow for a foul. It's a free kick to Atalanta in a dangerous position.
52' The ball goes out for a corner. Pisa can continue in their attacking effort.

49' Atalanta slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
48' Henrik Meister (Pisa) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
46' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Isak Hien (Atalanta) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. A free kick to Pisa.

44' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Pisa are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
40' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Matteo Marchetti didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
38' Samuele Angori (Pisa) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
34' The statistic for corner kicks – 5:0.
33' Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul. Atalanta will take a free kick near the side line.
28' Samuele Angori (Pisa) prepares to take a corner kick.
28' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Pisa.
26' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

25' Samuele Angori (Pisa) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Pisa will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
23' Henrik Meister (Pisa) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save!
21' The corner is swung in but Pisa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

21' A great solo run by Idrissa Toure (Pisa) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the right side of the goal was easily caught by Marco Carnesecchi. The ball goes out of play. Pisa are awarded a corner kick.
20' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Pisa earn a free kick.
19' A cross into the box from Idrissa Toure (Pisa) is cleared.
18' Marius Marin (Pisa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. Pisa will take a throw-in.
17' Atalanta seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

13' Yunus Musah (Atalanta) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team. There is a free kick near the sideline to Pisa.
13' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
8' A cross from a corner kick by Pisa is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
7' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle. Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) commits a foul after dangerous play. Pisa have been awarded a free kick.
6' There's an opportunity for Samuele Angori (Pisa) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
6' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Pisa have been awarded a corner kick.
5' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) commits a foul during an attacking move.
2' Neat passing move from Atalanta in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Pisa will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Matteo Marchetti.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
